name: Hemang Resources Limited
about: Hemang Resources Limited engages in the coal trading and infrastructure businesses in India. The company is involved in the trading of imported and indigenous coal and selling to various industries; and trades in land. It also provides stevedoring and logistic services. The company was formerly known as Bhatia Industries and Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Hemang Resources Limited in March 2015. Hemang Resources Limited was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Indore, India.
